misc.title: Misc Settings
misc.throw_exception: Throw exception instead of popup error message
misc.image_storage_hint: Uploaded images are stored this way: the folder mode writes files into UserUploadImage and keeps only a reference in the message; the Base64 mode embeds the image data in the message itself (travels with the chat, but messages get much larger).
misc.image_processing_hint: Original stores uploaded bytes as-is (identical to earlier versions). In Processed mode, images above the pixel budget are first scaled down proportionally and then re-encoded with the chosen algorithm, keeping storage and per-round request payloads small; images within the budget are untouched, and GIF animations plus tool-generated images are never modified.
misc.image_pixel_budget_hint: An image whose width × height exceeds this value is scaled down proportionally: 1024×1024 ≈ 1.05M, 2048×2048 ≈ 4.19M, 4096×4096 ≈ 16.78M.
misc.image_compression_hint: Images above the pixel budget are re-encoded in this format after scaling; “Scale only” keeps the original format (PNG stays lossless, so size savings are limited).
misc.image_quality_hint: Quality of lossy encoding (1-100; higher means sharper but larger).
